qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Validated bioprocess consumables (single-use bioreactor bags, sterile filters, chromatography media) embedded into regulatory biologic drug filings create insurmountable customer switching barriers and high cycle-average ROIC.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 5 (Management = 0, REJECT). World-class bioprocess consumable franchise with deep regulatory switching costs, but management committed severe capital allocation errors: debt-financing the €2.4B Polyplus acquisition at top-of-cycle multiples, blowing leverage past 4.5x EBITDA, and diluting shareholders with a €1B emergency equity raise.
qualitative.evidence: Gross margins exceed 50% with high recurring single-use consumable mix. However, management overleveraged the company into the bioprocess downturn via €2.4B Polyplus deal (€3B bond issuance at 4.4-4.9%), driving net debt/EBITDA >4.5x in 2023 and triggering a dilutive €1B equity capital increase in Q1 2024.
